items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I heard Miles early on and that influenced me

ctx.x: She came over and she heard Phineas and she said, “I gotta give him some. I just can’t help it. I just, he, you know. I may have to give it to him. All these guys in the band want to screw me, it’s like Doris Day or something, but I’m gonna give it to this guy cause he’s the one deserving it.” Somehow she made a rondeaveu with him and police found out about it, came with the billy clubs like they did to Miles and Bud Powell and stuff, and whooped the pee juice out of him, man. And that was the start of it, you…
